name: Schur number lower-bound coloring with six colors

source_review.human_source: Sol read Fredricksen–Sweet 2000 pp.2,6 and matched the six representative lists, including the 179/358 symmetry exception. The reconstructed six-color partition covers every integer 1..536.
source_review.public_source: Sol read arXiv:2610.31362v1 dated 2026-10-22: authors report a 537-element six-color partition and make no exact S(6) claim. Certificate commit 92a9d5f1336a5a064b2bfe6597d967f59191e365 is fixed. AI assistance remains undisclosed.
source_review.independent_check: All x<=y pairs, including x=y, checked separately for human536 and reference537; 143916 and 144453 pairs respectively. No monochromatic x+y=z.
source_review.normalization: Frozen human H remains536. Best reproduced reference is537, not the historical human536.
source_review.limits: This is a checked-source open-status review, not an exhaustive proof search.
